task: An image is available at: /home/user/Documents/silhouette.png. Open it in GIMP. Replace all white background pixels with transparency while preserving the black foreground shape unchanged. Save the result to: /home/user/Documents/cutout.png. The output must be a PNG image with an alpha channel.
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/silhouette.png in GIMP (a 300x300 RGB image with a black star on a white background). Add an alpha channel to the layer (Layer > Transparency > Add Alpha Channel). Then use Colors > Color to Alpha with white as the target color to convert the white background into transparency while keeping the black star opaque. Export as PNG to /home/user/Documents/cutout.png preserving transparency (the output must be RGBA).

verification.description: Former white corner is now fully transparent
Center of black star remains opaque

cli_feasibility.translation: Use Python with PIL: Load image, iterate pixels, set white pixels to transparent, save as PNG
cli_feasibility.reason: Color-to-alpha requires pixel manipulation - possible with PIL but not trivial
